items.title: Employees at Eric Trump-backed robot startup lose health benefits as company's cash crunch deepens
items.summary: Employees at Foundation Future Industries were told that their health benefits through administrator Rippling have been terminated, according to a memo obtained by CNBC, adding to mounting signs of financial distress at the humanoid robot startup advised and backed by Eric Trump .

items.title: I’ve been married for 58 years. It’s ‘our’ money, not ‘his’ and ‘hers.’ Why don’t others feel the same?
items.summary: ## ‘My wife stopped working outside the home in 1970’ Choose MarketWatch as a preferred source of financial news As a regular reader of The Moneyist, I am puzzled by letters from married couples that talk about , her spending and his saving; he shares but she doesn’t, or vice versa; and money issues that seem to portray two people living separate financial lives, not a married couple, not ours, but yours and mine.
